title: Enroll request
description: POST /api/v1/enroll. Unauthenticated apart from the single-use enrollment token (DEC-04).

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

token.description: Single-use enrollment token issued by the operator. Secret: never logged.

hostname.description: Hostname as the agent sees it, or null if unreadable.

machine_id.description: Contents of /etc/machine-id, or null if unreadable. Recorded as the host's identity for clone detection (FR-S.1).
